objective: The detector of a contract stored in a local file flags the names of contract files and nothing else.

criteria.text: No legitimate file name (a version, a status code, an issue template) is flagged as a local contract
A contract file named in Portuguese is flagged

fails: a false alarm on a legitimate name; a contract file that escapes
outOfScope: a folder named without a file
env: Node 24 and the standard library; the proof runs with node --test in a copy of this folder
output: the verdict of the critic on the issue
